versioning.policy: Public product versioning begins with SC-050 at v0.1.0. Patch releases fix behaviour, minor releases add user-visible capability, and major releases require an explicitly approved stable milestone.

historyNote: Formal production release history is shown from SC-015 onward, where the current Git history uses identifiable Shateki release IDs. Earlier development commits are intentionally not assigned invented public version numbers.

releases.title: Volde-D’eux / Volde-Trois Misfires
changes: Added Volde-D’eux for D1–D5 hits in the Doubles round and Volde-Trois for T1–T5 hits in the Trebles round.
Each qualifying dart stacks independently at −2 XP in Official/Classic games from the existing Misfire XP launch boundary.
Historical Official/Classic occurrences remain visible without backdating negative XP.

releases.title: Version & Release Notes
changes: Added a small production version number to the Home screen.
Tap the version to open a scrollable Release Notes history.
Version and release notes now come from one canonical shipped metadata source.

releases.title: DMD pacing and motion polish
changes: Improved DMD story timing and readability.
Made MISS x2/x3 faster and punchier.
Preserved already-scored darts correctly during MISS animations.

releases.title: Stateful DMD commentary
changes: Added per-dart commentary, end-of-go verdicts and end-of-round punchlines.
Added deficit, miss-streak and history-aware commentary without changing scoring.

releases.title: Landscape TV Mode beta
changes: Added a provisional 16:9 audience display for Classic live games.
Kept the existing scoring engine and normal Live Game as the source of truth.

releases.title: Persistent player avatars
changes: Added 29 persistent player avatars and Player Hub editing.
Carried avatars through setup, throw order and winner celebrations.

releases.title: Catch-up focus and expired-skip markers
changes: Kept the scheduled table viewport fixed during catch-up.
Used orange catch-up focus for the oldest recoverable round and X for older scratched rounds.

releases.title: Visible Live V2 skip marker
changes: Moved the skipped-round marker into the visible Live V2 score cell.
Kept scoring and catch-up truth unchanged.

releases.title: Skip marker and Add Player touch fix
changes: Improved the physical-iPhone skipped-round marker.
Fixed the Game Menu → Add Player confirmation path on iPhone Safari.

releases.title: Implicit Skip return and mobile Add Player
changes: Skip Go now resumes catch-up implicitly on the next scheduled scoring input.
Improved mobile Add Player positioning and confirmation.

releases.title: Add Player and rules-aware Skip Go
changes: Added in-game Add Player.
Added rules-aware Skip Go including the final-Bull return timer.

releases.title: Automatic match throw-order rotation
changes: Added AUTO ON rotation of the starting player between Match Play games.
Preserved manual/re-cork behaviour with AUTO OFF.

releases.title: Post-game acceptance fixes
changes: Changed GAME OVER to a centred slow pulse.
Removed STATS from Match Leaderboard and routed GAME SCORES to the shared scorecard.

releases.title: Milestone boards and post-game presentation
changes: Corrected non-score milestone leaderboard families.
Improved DMD NEXT UP layout and Match Leaderboard presentation.

releases.title: Milestone and record integrity
changes: Fixed threshold-specific milestone leaderboards.
Restored PB/record notification precedence and cleaned Round Record holder display.

releases.title: DMD arcade language and pinball motion
changes: Refreshed live DMD callouts, round/turn information and record presentation.
Added procedural arcade scenes and reduced-motion support.

releases.title: DMD ownership and sequencing hardening
changes: Removed duplicate DMD writers and destructive clears.
Protected DMD state against stale Skip, Undo and new-throw timers.

releases.title: Detailed post-game XP sources
changes: Added BASE XP, POSITIVE and NEGATIVE source rows to the XP stage.

releases.title: Animated XP and Match Leaderboard recovery
changes: Restored the animated XP/rewards stage.
Fixed achievement detection and the Match Leaderboard handoff.

releases.title: Post-game result → scorecard → XP flow
changes: Added the dedicated game scorecard and refined Game Complete presentation.
Restored the canonical XP and next-game/finish-match flow.

releases.title: Current-round targets in score cells
changes: Restored the original score layout while keeping square targets in the live current-round cells.

releases.title: Live Game / DMD V2 modular release
changes: Released the modular DMD V2 controller and browser/runtime regression gates.
Added reduced-motion support and final responsive Live Game framing.

releases.title: Modular architecture migration
changes: Moved the app to verified modular source ownership and a deterministic Vite build path.
Preserved the existing compatibility runtime while improving build and release safety.

releases.title: Player Stats polish and Power Rank restore
changes: Kept the Player Stats profile fixed while the lower menu scrolls.
Restored Power Rank through the verified Official game-score path.

releases.title: Milestone and percentage average boards
changes: Added ALL TIME / AVERAGE views to Milestones.
Added percentage qualification treatment across achievements and misfires.

releases.title: Live Game HUD and Throwpad polish
changes: Refined Live Game HUD hierarchy and Throwpad presentation.

releases.title: Classic race chart motion redesign
changes: Redesigned Classic race-chart motion while preserving game state.

releases.title: Classic Live Game visual modernisation
changes: Modernised Classic Live Game visuals and aligned throwpad action columns.
